Sofia Patel: hi everyone, i'm Sofia on infra — quick Q while setting up my laptop: how do I request Vault read access + a KMS-wrapped test key for onboarding? any gotchas about rotation or TTLs?
Ibrahim Al-Mansour: welcome Sofia! :tada: short flow:
1) fill https://redwood.internal/onboarding/secrets and pick team=infra
2) ask your manager to reply in the ticket for approval
3) devex will grant `secrets-readers` for read-only paths; write/KMS roles need eng-security review
Sofia Patel: thanks — whats the norm for TTLs on dev creds? i'd prefer not to accidentally get long-lived tokens.
Ibrahim Al-Mansour: dev-sandbox creds are typical: TTL 4h. CLI leases 1h-24h. Production service creds rotate every 90 days by default. If you need longer, include justification + approver in the ticket.
Sofia Patel: any commands/examples to fetch the secret locally?
Ibrahim Al-Mansour: yes — example to read a password:
```
vault kv get -field=password secret/team/infra/dev-db
```
For KMS-symmetric ops we gate via cloud IAM; we don't hand out raw unwrapped keys. If you need to encrypt locally, request a KMS-encrypt role and we create a wrapped-test-key.
DevEx Bot: Hi Sofia  placeholder workflow created. Steps:
- Submit onboarding form
- Attach manager approval to ticket
- For KMS, add a short justification (e.g., "encrypting local test fixtures")
- Eng-security review ≈ 1 business day
SecurityBot: Note: please avoid storing plaintext keys in repo. Use secrets manager or env injection in CI. Rotation policy link: https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets/rotation
Sofia Patel: great, submitted form and opened ticket SEC-4672 with manager note. Requested sandbox creds first. I'll update when approved. Thanks! :thumbsup:
